coral.rationale: Predicate 1 derives mandatory outcomes from the signed order independently of the registry. R9 has no required goal or narration output. The legacy adapter passes its registered required goals but misses this coverage gap.

silver.rationale: Predicate 1 requires original-order coverage by required goals. Optional G8 cannot satisfy mandatory R2; R9 and R4 are absent. The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail, so its required-item checks pass vacuously.

opal.rationale: All mandatory outputs pass, but predicate 6 and the final-transition authority guard prohibit a new success notification: S27 stopped this order before publication. The legacy adapter does not recheck the stop stream at its final transition.

cedar.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R4 with R5, and all currently mandatory outcomes have required goals with passing criteria and usable outputs. Under predicate 6, X16 does not bind this order; the current-scope and authority guards permit publication.
